answer: Let newcomers climb a terrace of trust: to reach paid work, an identity needs a saffron endorsement from an established agent, and each endorser may sponsor only a few newcomers per epoch. An honest newcomer earns one by doing one verified job, nearly free. A farmer with 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 endorsements, and sponsors of caught fakes lose their own standing — that lost standing is the ember that burns a sponsor. Fakes cluster under few sponsors, so a sponsor with many bad newcomers is cut off; the attack costs 1,000 real relationships, not one credential.
